text:
maria: quick q — we're adding an optional top-level `cached_tokens` breakdown to the /v1/usage response. two things: 1) will this break SDK mappings if we keep `prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens` unchanged, and 2) should cached tokens be treated as billable by default or opt-in? cc @kai

kai: short answers: SDKs won't break as long as we keep existing fields and make the new keys optional. please don't rename `prompt_tokens`/`completion_tokens` — add `cached_tokens` + `cached_origin` instead.

kai: billing policy: cached tokens are NOT billable by default. we have an opt-in flag `charge_cached_tokens` that customers can enable per-account. that is surfaced in billing config, not in /v1/usage. usage response can include `billing_flags` for visibility.

alex: +1 to keeping old fields. filing a small PR with the contract change now: #4421. sample response we're prototyping: ```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 24,
  "completion_tokens": 76,
  "cached_tokens": 20,
  "cached_origin": "prefix_cache",
  "billing_flags": { "charge_cached_tokens": false }
}
```

sam: FYI we need a deterministic way to reconcile cached tokens in the billing pipeline — add a `token_lineage_id` on the usage record so accounting can attribute cached tokens back to the originating prompt. otherwise recon will be messy.

maria: good call. kai/eng-infra — can we add `token_lineage_id` (opaque string) to the usage event schema? that should be optional for older events.

kai: yes we can add optional `token_lineage_id`. it will be empty for legacy events. we'll update the event contract and the kafka schema change. I'll drop a migration plan in the PR.

nisha: SDK impact: we'll map `cached_tokens` into the existing Usage object as `cached_tokens` (nullable) and expose `billing_flags.charge_cached_tokens` as read-only. will add unit tests for backward compat. ping me for code review @maria.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #4421 (main -> staging) :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all — i'll update the API contract doc in the repo, add a short changelog entry about `cached_tokens` + `token_lineage_id`, and link the billing policy. tagging @nisha for SDK review and @kai for the kafka schema change. :thumbsup:
